items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a genuine four-keyframe swim animation sprite sheet for an existing 2D anime aquarium game character.
The input image is the APPROVED CHARACTER MASTER. Create four distinct physically drawn animation poses of EXACTLY this same character. Preserve its identity, species, camera angle, proportions, eye, mouth, expression, colors, markings, linework and rendering style. Do not redesign or simplify the approved art.

SHEET FORMAT: exactly FOUR frames in an invisible 2-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid on one SQUARE canvas. Reading order is upper-left frame 0, upper-right frame 1, lower-left frame 2, lower-right frame 3. All four grid cells are equal. Every cell contains ONE complete full-body character facing RIGHT, with generous transparent margins. Keep body/head position, body scale, head angle and all static features registered to the SAME relative coordinates in every cell. No whole-character translation, bobbing, zooming, rotating or flipping between frames. The sheet will be sliced into equal cells and packed into a horizontal game atlas.
Draw a real repeating movement cycle in the specified appendages, not four identical copies, not four unrelated concept poses, and not simple whole-body squashing or image warping. The last pose should naturally lead back into the first. Keep each character entirely within its own cell, with no limb touching a cell edge or another frame.

Rendering: identical polished hand-drawn 2D anime artwork to the source master. Preserve the fine contours, facial expression and clear shaded color design. Same lighting and colors in every frame. Keep the face and eye OPEN and unchanged; no blinking or new expressions. No new patterns, missing parts, extra anatomy, props or costume.

BACKGROUND: actual transparent alpha across all unused pixels and gaps between cells. No scenery, floor, shadow, aura/glow, bubbles, motion trails, arrows, frame numbers, labels, text, borders, divider lines, watermark or painted checkerboard.

CHARACTER: 青芽海龟, the exact green-shell turtle in the reference. Four flippers total and one tiny tail in every frame. Its shell, shell-plate pattern, head/neck length, green eye, smile and torso must be locked and stable.
SWIM CYCLE: animate the broad front flippers in a gentle alternating paddling cycle, with small coordinated rear-flipper changes.
Frame 0: near front flipper at the neutral downward diagonal; far front flipper held slightly back.
Frame 1: near front flipper sweeps forward/upward and becomes a little more foreshortened; far front flipper extends down/back.
Frame 2: near front flipper makes the downward/backward power stroke, visibly below its frame-0 angle; far front flipper starts rising.
Frame 3: near front flipper relaxes back toward neutral with a slight bend in perspective; far front flipper raised, ready to return to frame 0.
Move the flippers at their proper shoulder/hip joints. Four broad sea-turtle flippers only, no fingers or extra limbs. Do not deform the shell or move the head to fake the stroke. Gentle, calm movement, not a frantic bird-flap.

CHARACTER: 绮霞古比, the exact slender apricot/cream fish with rosy-pink large scalloped fan tail, ruby anime eye and SMALL three-point gold crown in the reference. Lock the head, torso, crown shape/position, face and body markings; keep its approved elegant guppy proportions.
SWIM CYCLE: animate the fan tail at its narrow tail stem, with a little coordinated pectoral-fin movement.
Frame 0: fan tail broadly open in the neutral plane, with a slight upward tip sweep.
Frame 1: tail sweeps toward the viewer, subtly foreshortened and narrower; its lower lobe curls gently back.
Frame 2: fan opens broadly on the opposite stroke with a slight downward tip sweep.
Frame 3: tail passes back through a softly folded/narrower phase toward the neutral plane, leading into frame 0.
The tail must show different folds and fin-ray poses, while keeping the same three main scalloped lobes, color layout and tail attachment. Keep movements moderate, do not turn it into a different tail or make the fish breathe in size. The small crown is rigid and attached to the same head location in all four frames. Do not bounce or wobble the crown independently.

CHARACTER: 珊澜蝶鱼, the exact warm ivory butterflyfish with coral-orange back/fins, light aqua edging, a short aqua curved marking BEHIND the eye, and the same small cluster of FOUR warm coral petal-like marks near the rear upper flank. Preserve its short deep body, small paddle tail, teal-green anime eye and cheerful face.
SWIM CYCLE: near-side pectoral-fin paddling, restrained little-tail strokes, small trailing edge ripples in the dorsal and anal fins.
Frame 0: pectoral fin relaxed diagonally back, short tail neutral.
Frame 1: pectoral fin fans outward and slightly forward/up, short tail sweeps a little upward.
Frame 2: pectoral fin sweeps downward/back and is partly folded in perspective, short tail returns through neutral.
Frame 3: pectoral fin recovers toward the initial relaxed angle, short tail sweeps a little downward before returning to frame 0.
The pectoral fin must have a visibly different outline in each key pose; make a real paddling cycle. Keep the BODY and face steady. Dorsal/anal fin motion is subtle, without growing or changing their overall species shape. The aqua eye marking and four little coral markings remain at the SAME body positions with the SAME count and shapes in every frame. No original dark eye stripe or dark oval spot, and no yellow or purple recolor.
